title: sambucus racemosa f. laciniata
intro: Sambucus racemosa f. laciniata, commonly known as cut-leaved elder, is a shrub or small tree that is native to North America. This plant has been traditionally used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, relieving cold and flu symptoms, and treating respiratory issues due to its antiviral and anti-inflammatory properties. The therapeutic actions of Sambucus racemosa f. laciniata include expectorant, antiviral, and anti-inflammatory effects, which help to relieve congestion, soothe sore throats, and reduce fever. The bioactive constituents of this plant include sambunigrin, sambunigrin glycoside, and other flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
